minecraft_campfire_signal_smoke.description: A single large rounded gray-beige puff/blob hovers just above the horizon in every front and threequarter frame at all three ticks; it sits slightly higher/closer in threequarter views and stays essentially static in size and shape across t3/t8/t20. Top views show only the persistent brown dirt-debris background.
minecraft_campfire_signal_smoke.notes: Slightly clipped by the top edge of threequarter cells, so full height may be underestimated.

minecraft_dripping_dripstone_lava.description: Sparse tiny orange square droplets (3-5 per frame) float in mid-air at scattered heights in front/threequarter t3 and t8; by t20 they appear as small red-orange marks resting on the grass at the right side. Top t20 also shows a few small red-orange dashes among the background debris.
minecraft_dripping_dripstone_lava.notes: Very few pixels per frame; easy to miss at normal scale.

minecraft_effect.description: A loose cluster of 5-6 white/pale spiral-ring outline particles hovers just above the horizon at front t3, with a faint remnant in threequarter t3. Completely gone by t8 in all angles; top views show only background debris.
minecraft_effect.notes: Distinctive spiral rings confirmed in magnified crop; very short-lived.

minecraft_falling_dripstone_lava.description: A few small bright orange-red flat dashes lie on the grass at ground level in front/threequarter views (1-4 per frame) at all ticks. Top view shows orange-red specks embedded in the background debris cluster at t3/t8 and a lone dash at t20.
minecraft_falling_dripstone_lava.notes: Particles rest at ground level; distinguishable from the brown debris pile by color.

minecraft_fishing.description: A small cluster of roughly 8-10 dark-blue irregular droplet/blob specks sits just above the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views; only 2-3 faint blue specks remain at t8; nothing at t20. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_fishing.notes: Low-contrast dark blue on blue sky reduces apparent visibility.

minecraft_infested.description: Roughly 6-8 dark gray angular spiky specks — small bug/mite-shaped motes — cluster above the horizon at front t3 and 3-4 at threequarter t3; all side views are empty at t8 and t20. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_infested.notes: Magnified crop shows spiky critter silhouettes rather than plain dots.

minecraft_lava.description: At front t3 a loose vertical spray of ~15-20 irregular dark-gray/black chunky specks rises above the horizon with a tiny orange ember near the top edge; only a few specks remain by t8. Threequarter shows a handful of drifting dark specks still in mid-air at t8 and even t20. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_lava.notes: Mostly dark smoke-like specks rather than the expected orange; the tiny orange speck is only at the top edge.

minecraft_scrape.description: A sparse cluster of small pale teal-green 4-point star sparkles hovers just above the horizon at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views (about 4-6 per frame); gone by t20. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_scrape.notes: Fewer and dimmer than the world_event scrape variant; star shapes verified in crop.

minecraft_sonic_boom.description: One giant flat saturated teal disc/ellipse sits low over the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views (~3-4 blocks wide, partially clipped by the cell top); both angles are completely empty at t8 and t20. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_sonic_boom.notes: Reads as a solid disc rather than a ring at this capture tick; may be mid-expansion.

minecraft_trial_spawner_detection.description: Four to five tiny vertical orange dashes — elongated rounded rectangles with pale peach/white cores — hang in a loose vertical column above the horizon at front t3 only; every other frame including all threequarter and top cells is empty except background debris.
minecraft_trial_spawner_detection.notes: Visible only from the front camera; confirms a very localized/small effect.

minecraft_witch.description: A cluster of roughly 5-7 magenta-purple X-shaped sparkles plus a few small purple dots floats above the horizon at front t3, with a fainter version at threequarter t3; all frames are empty by t8. Top views show only background debris.
minecraft_witch.notes: X-shaped sparkle morphology verified in magnified crop.

world_event_PARTICLES_AND_SOUND_WAX_ON.description: A burst of ~15-20 small orange-gold 4-point star sparkles appears above the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views, thinning to ~8-10 stars at t8 and nothing at t20. Top views show only background debris.

world_event_PARTICLES_SCRAPE.description: A burst of ~12-15 green-teal star/cross sparkles fills the air above the horizon at t3, shrinking to ~6-8 at t8 with a few pale ones still visible at front t20; threequarter is similar through t8. Top views show only background debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_SCRAPE.notes: Denser and greener than the minecraft_scrape variant; longer tail.

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_SPAW.description: A dense burst of ~15-20 small orange-yellow flame/teardrop particles rises in a scattered column at t3 with a few dark-gray smoke motes mixed in; ~5-6 flames remain at t8 and 2-3 tiny orange specks at t20. Threequarter shows the same pattern at lower density. Top views show only background debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_SPAW.notes: Mixed flame + dark smoke specks verified in magnified crop.

superheroes_cap_shield_trail.description: A single chunky solid-orange blocky blob with a hard-edged stepped pixel silhouette (~1 block) hovers above the horizon and drifts steadily rightward across t3/t8 in front and threequarter views, partially exiting the right edge of the frame by t20. Top views show only background debris.
superheroes_cap_shield_trail.notes: Reads as one moving sprite rather than a particle spray; motion direction consistent across angles.

superheroes_homelander_flight_boost.description: All six front and threequarter frames equal the empty baseline (flat grass plus sky horizon) at every tick; top views contain only the persistent brown dirt-debris background. No effect pixels observed anywhere.
superheroes_homelander_flight_boost.notes: Effect may be sub-threshold, mis-anchored, or produce no particles; pixel-diff vs baseline confirms empty cells.

superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_1.description: A handful (~6-10) of tiny white specks clusters above the horizon at t3 in front and threequarter views, diminishing to ~3-4 specks at t8 and ~2-3 at t20. Verified in magnified crop — real but extremely small. Top views show only background debris.
superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_1.notes: White pixels blend into sky at normal scale; visible only after magnification.

superheroes_repulsor_spark.description: A soft cyan-blue glowing blob (~1 block, pixelated irregular silhouette with a brighter mottled core) floats above the horizon at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views; only faint cyan residue marks remain at the right edge at t20. Top views show only background debris.
superheroes_repulsor_spark.notes: Softer/glowier than vanilla flat sprites; bright core confirmed in crop.

superheroes_sword_explosion.description: Roughly 8-10 tiny white specks sit above the horizon at t3 in front view (verified in magnified crop), with a few fainter specks persisting at t8 and t20; threequarter shows a similar sparse scatter. Top views show only background debris.
superheroes_sword_explosion.notes: Nearly identical appearance to superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_1 in this capture set; very low pixel budget.
